headline: Mainland Chinese Tourist Outbound Spending Projected to Fall 4.3%
summary: Outbound travel spending by mainland Chinese tourists is forecast to decline by 4.3% this year despite higher overall trip volumes. Data indicates tourists favor shorter nearby destinations and lower leisure spending.
why: Outbound Chinese tourism spending is a major revenue source for retail, hospitality, and aviation sectors across Asia. Shifting consumer budget preferences impacts regional consumer economic growth.
